critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Main Wing' primitive geometry by applying a linear taper to the leading and trailing edges. Set the wing root width at 15 units, tapering to a tip width of 6 units over a span of 40 units. Rotate the wing segments backward along the longitudinal axis by 30 degrees to achieve the required sweep angle, ensuring the swept leading edge aligns with the fuselage's aerodynamic profile.
